diffuseAlbedo.source: Substances/travertine.json: optics.measuredColour[0].cieLab (Olivillo travertine, sawn vein-cut; Urosevic, Sebastian-Pardo & Cardell 2010)
diffuseAlbedo.note: A Spanish travertine stands in for Tivoli's until a specimen is measured (the record's unverified optics.measuredColour).

refractiveIndex.source: Substances/travertine.json: optics.specularF0 (0.0533, calcite grains in random orientations)
refractiveIndex.derivation: n = (1 + sqrt(F0)) / (1 - sqrt(F0)), the index whose normal-incidence reflectance is the record's F0

wettingDepth.note: The depth open voids reach, taken as the depth whose pores govern the face's look; the record calls it a procedural value, not a measurement.

grain.note: The largest pores of the matrix: the finest structure a face shows at gallery distances.

bed.source: Substances/travertine.json: unverified surface.bandSpacing (no measured band spacing)
bed.note: A first value for the band a vein-cut face shows, until a specimen of Travertino Romano is measured.

bedAspect.source: Substances/travertine.json: surface.voids.elongatedPoreLength (2 mm) and elongatedPoreWidth (1 mm)

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock fracture surfaces; no measurement of a worked travertine face was read.

toneSpread.source: Substances/travertine.json: optics.measuredColour (rows L* 62 to 70 between specimens)
toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across a face; the measured rows are specimen means, not the spread within one face.

roughnessSpread.source: Workings/honed.json: unverified surface.microRoughness (no filtered roughness read)
roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across a honed face.
